src/.purpose: verify the runner logic and CLI contract

corpus/sqlite_parity/generated_manifest..purpose: verify the embedded pinned SQLite parity manifest parses and matches expected counts

corpus/sqlite_parity/cases/.purpose: verify every new SQLite parity case passes sqlite3↔sqlite3 self-compare before shipping

corpus/sqlite_parity/rules/.purpose: verify generated shards match their rule files

corpus/beyond_sqlite/.purpose: verify every beyond-SQLite case passes psql↔psql self-compare before shipping

metadata/.purpose: verify the packaged beyond-SQLite metadata parses

tests/.purpose: verify Rust integration tests for parity, beyond-SQLite, release manifest integrity, timing/memory invariants

xtask/.purpose: verify the corpus generator builds and produces drift-free shards

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: verify the GitHub CI workflow stays aligned with the local CI, badge, and oracle lanes

.github/workflows/release.yml.purpose: verify the GitHub release workflow stays aligned with the local packaging and publish surface

justfile.purpose: verify the local release tarball and checksum

scripts/ci-local.sh.purpose: verify the PR CI and release validation surface stays executable locally

.jankurai/.purpose: verify control-plane edits do not break runner tests
